newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Port conditions update - Bangladesh - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Bangladesh - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
CHITTAGONG, May 20 - A severe cyclone hit the Chittagong south-eastern coasts from 1400 to 2030, local time, May 19, with maximum sustained winds of 180 to 200 kph.
One shore crane boom fell onto jetty and was damaged, and approximately 20 to 25 containers fell from their third height stowed position at container yard.
Electricity and water supplies very badly affected by the conditions.
Numerous ships broke moorings and some were damaged.
